narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A behind-the-scenes deep dive explaining how the 'HahaTai' production team used AI technology to create simulated street interviews. The creators discuss the preparation process, the rapid evolution of AI tools, and the philosophical question of whether AI can truly replace the unique human thoughts captured in authentic street interviews.
